body.name: Harbor City Council
body.description: A made-up council with made-up people, here to show every state the tracker can display. Nothing in it is real.

other_bodies.name: Harbor Port Authority Board
other_bodies.description: A second made-up body. Two of its members also sit on the council, to show one question put to both.

questions.title: Should the harbor ferry be free to ride?
questions.description: Whether the city should drop fares on the cross-harbor ferry and fund it from the general budget.

questions.title: Have they signed on to Ordinance 26-114?
questions.description: The specific measure on the table: a two-year fare-free pilot paid for by a berth fee on cruise ships.

questions.title: Will she publish the fiscal note before the vote?
questions.description: The council does not vote on a spending measure until the budget chair has published its fiscal note.
questions.closed_note: The fiscal note was published on October 30.

questions.title: Have they pledged not to take cruise line money?
questions.description: A pledge to refuse campaign donations from cruise operators. It is about the person, so it is put to the council and the port board alike, and someone who sits on both has one answer.
